searchText: Does anyone have suggestions how to generate exits or proposer slashings on a Kurtosis network? I started running asertoor but it takes like 48-72 hours. But I'm at the limits of my kurtosis knowledge and would appreciate any pointers 🙏 https://github.com/ethpandaops/assertoor/issues/67
